answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to flood the hollow network with fake identities faces prohibitive costs, as gaining influence requires purchasing tokens, rendering any meadow of sybil accounts economically irrational. Saffron emission schedules further disincentivize such behavior by ensuring that returns on staked assets remain tied to resource commitment rather than sheer identity count.
